# FAMILY-LITERALS · the galeed family literal registry

Family component `family-literals`, family version 5, kept in this registry's own form (ZIKARON e059ff51 keeps the same component as `crates/app/family-literals.json`).

The registry file of the family literals. It registers every literal of this family by role, each with its sources. **The registry is the contract; the checker is a gauge**: no repeat within a role; across roles only the registered pairs repeat; no literal equals any literal of the zikaron family; a signing key signs only registered domains, and only those its seat may sign (`seats`); a new paper or prefix is registered before it is used. Each entry names the place in the code that defines the literal for this register (its `at`); a test reads this file and checks each entry against that place, both ways. Entries whose `note` calls them contact paths are literals another program reads when it reads this product's data.

## 1 · Machine-readable form

This file holds exactly **one** ` ```json ` fenced block, the registry itself; text outside the fence is explanation only and the checker does not read it. The block's shape:

- `registry` and `formatVersion`: the registry name and format version;
- `roles`: the closed set of roles; the key is the role name, the value a one-sentence definition;
- `entries`: a list of `{literal, role, sources, note?, pairedWith?, abi?, seats?, use?, at}`; `literal` byte for byte; `role` from `roles`; `at` the one place in the code that holds the literal now: a constant's path (an array member as `…::NAME[1]`; for a `registry-abi` name, the constant holding its signature, whose name before the parenthesis is the literal), or for a literal the product takes by `use` name, the consumer's accessor that takes it; `null` when the code spells it nowhere, the `note` then saying why. The public test `crates/app/tests/family_literals.rs` checks both ways that each `at` holds its literal and that each place its table lists has an entry; `sources` non-empty, each either "law text §section" or a path in this tree that defines it; `pairedWith` only on paired entries, naming the other role; `abi` only on the `registry-abi` role, carrying `{kind, signature}`; `seats` only on the `signing-domain` role, the closed list of seats that may sign the domain (within `judge` · `guild` · `verifier`; the guild signs no domain, so `guild` never appears); `use` on the `derivation-purpose` role (the product takes the purpose string by this name), and on the `zikaron-contact` and `kit-prefix` roles (the product takes the literal by this name, with no second spelling in the source);
- `pairs`: the paired literals (a paper's root `kind` and its signing domain are the same literal);
- `foreign`: the literals of the other families this registry records for the distinctness check, a list in the family's form (each item's `literals`, when it has any); beside them the checker reads the two zikaron law texts afresh;
- `derivationPaths`: the family derivation path table: `form` is the path shape, `entries` a list of `{path, family, project, role}`; the third segment of `path` is `project` followed by `'`, and the index may be the placeholder `{i}`.
- `data`: constants from the same sources as the literals (the payload cap, the registry, succession book and router codeHashes, the cost bounds for importing a key file); not literals and not in the uniqueness check; the product takes them by name through `galeed::literals::datum`, with no second spelling in the source.

The checker's thirteen readings: ① no repeated `(literal, role)` pair in `entries`; ② a `literal` under two roles carries `pairedWith` on both sides pointing at the other, and the set of such literals equals `pairs` (no count is fixed; each pair both ways); ③ no `literal` in `entries` equals any literal `foreign` records, nor any domain or spec literal taken afresh from the two zikaron law texts; ④ the literal set of the `signing-domain` role equals the union of the two closed tables taken from galeed/1 §5.6 and galeed.papers/1 §3.2 (five members); ⑤ one equality per contract source: the function and event names of `registry-abi` equal the set taken from `base/galeed-core/contracts/src/GaleedRegistry.sol`, and those of `book-abi` the set taken from `base/galeed-core/contracts/src/GaleedSuccessionBook.sol`; ⑥ the product's allowed-domain table for its signing API equals the `signing-domain` set; ⑦ every `role` in `entries` is in the `roles` closed set; ⑧ `derivationPaths.entries` is non-empty, every `path` fits `form` (`m/44'/60'/project'/group/index`, group and index decimal, the index may be `{i}`) with the project number equal to `project`, paths pairwise distinct, `(family, role)` pairwise distinct; ⑨ galeed.roster/1 §8 is read in two columns, its kinds and its reserved prefixes kept apart: the literal set of the `pointer-prefix` role equals the pointer prefix taken from §8, and the `document-kind` entries whose `sources` cite that law equal the kind closed table taken from §8 (a prefix, ending in `/`, is never a kind); ⑩ the one `Anchored` signature: the signature taken from galeed/1 §9.1 in the topic 0 preimage form (`keccak256("…")`) is exactly one, equals the product's constant (`kit::ANCHORED_CARRIED_SIGNATURE`), and equals the registry's signatures named `Anchored` (the union of `abi.signature` under `registry-abi` and the parenthesized literals under `venue-interface`); ⑪ the literal set of the `basis-member` role equals the product's one basis constant (`audit::BASIS_CHAINS`), and each appears verbatim in backticks in galeed/1 §9.4; ⑫ seats: every `signing-domain` entry carries non-empty `seats` whose members are in the three-seat closed set without `guild`, the literal set carrying `seats` equals the union of the two law tables of ④, and the product's per-(seat, domain) allowance table equals this registry's, pair by pair (`sign::registered_domains_by_seat`). ⑬ the `reserved-prefix` role equals the union of the prefixes the two laws reserve (the reserved prefixes of galeed.roster/1 §8 and the prefix galeed.papers/1 §7a.3 quotes), and no entry of any other role begins with a reserved prefix unless every one of its `sources` is a law text (the law's own kinds); a product kind under any reserved prefix is refused here.

```json
    { "literal": "who", "role": "registry-abi", "sources": ["base/galeed-core/contracts/src/GaleedRegistry.sol", "galeed.roster/1 §1"], "abi": {"kind": "parameter", "signature": "address indexed who"}, "note": "the first member of StatusChanged: the address that called `setStatus` No place of its own in the code: a parameter name, spelled only inside the registry's `sol!` declaration.", "at": null },
    { "literal": "active", "role": "registry-abi", "sources": ["base/galeed-core/contracts/src/GaleedRegistry.sol", "galeed.roster/1 §1"], "abi": {"kind": "parameter", "signature": "bool active"}, "note": "the only parameter of setStatus and the second member of StatusChanged No place of its own in the code: a parameter name, spelled only inside the registry's `sol!` declaration.", "at": null },
    { "literal": "sender", "role": "registry-abi", "sources": ["base/galeed-core/contracts/src/GaleedRegistry.sol", "galeed/1 §9.1"], "abi": {"kind": "parameter", "signature": "address indexed sender"}, "note": "the first member of Anchored: topic 1, the transaction's sender No place of its own in the code: a parameter name, spelled only inside the registry's `sol!` declaration.", "at": null },
    { "literal": "hash", "role": "registry-abi", "sources": ["base/galeed-core/contracts/src/GaleedRegistry.sol", "galeed/1 §9.1"], "abi": {"kind": "parameter", "signature": "bytes32 indexed hash"}, "note": "the anchored hash: the first parameter of anchorCarried and the second member of Anchored (topic 2), the sha256 of the entry No place of its own in the code: a parameter name, spelled only inside the registry's `sol!` declaration.", "at": null },
    { "literal": "entry", "role": "registry-abi", "pairedWith": "keyed-label", "sources": ["base/galeed-core/contracts/src/GaleedRegistry.sol", "galeed/1 §9.1"], "abi": {"kind": "parameter", "signature": "bytes entry"}, "note": "the entry's bytes: the second parameter of anchorCarried and the third member of Anchored; spelled like the keyed label `entry`, a coincidence listed as a pair No place of its own in the code: a parameter name, spelled only inside the registry's `sol!` declaration.", "at": null },
    { "literal": "hashes", "role": "registry-abi", "sources": ["base/galeed-core/contracts/src/GaleedRegistry.sol", "galeed/1 §9.1"], "abi": {"kind": "parameter", "signature": "bytes32[] hashes"}, "note": "the first parameter of anchorCarriedMany No place of its own in the code: a parameter name, spelled only inside the registry's `sol!` declaration.", "at": null },
    { "literal": "entries", "role": "registry-abi", "sources": ["base/galeed-core/contracts/src/GaleedRegistry.sol", "galeed/1 §9.1"], "abi": {"kind": "parameter", "signature": "bytes[] entries"}, "note": "the second parameter of anchorCarriedMany No place of its own in the code: a parameter name, spelled only inside the registry's `sol!` declaration.", "at": null },
    { "literal": "chains", "role": "basis-member", "sources": ["galeed/1 §9.4"], "note": "the one member of the basis object: the per-chain window list. In the product it lives only in galeed::audit::BASIS_CHAINS, which the scanner and the command line borrow", "at": "galeed::audit::BASIS_CHAINS" },

    { "literal": "recovery", "role": "derivation-purpose", "pairedWith": "vault-member", "use": "master-recovery", "sources": ["crates/galeed/src/cryptox.rs"], "note": "the recovery key R = HKDF-SHA256(the primary identity's seed, recovery_salt, this string); the product takes it through galeed::literals::derivation_purpose(\"master-recovery\"), and cryptox writes no second copy", "at": "galeed::literals::derivation_purpose(galeed::cryptox::vault::USE_RECOVERY)" },
    { "literal": "galeed cli-sent/1", "role": "derivation-purpose", "use": "cli-sent", "sources": ["crates/galeed-send/src/sent.rs"], "note": "the HKDF purpose of the seal over the command line's record of a direct anchoring (`galeed_send::sent`): sealed to the sending key, so a rerun reads its own record and no other key's", "at": "galeed_send::sent::SEAL_INFO" },
    { "literal": "galeed-age/1", "role": "derivation-purpose", "use": "age-identity", "sources": ["crates/galeed/src/cryptox.rs"], "note": "each identity's age identity = HKDF-SHA256(that identity's seed or private key, no salt, this string); one mnemonic computes the same one on two machines. The product takes it through galeed::literals::derivation_purpose(\"age-identity\")", "at": "galeed::literals::derivation_purpose(galeed::cryptox::vault::USE_AGE)" },
    { "literal": "galeed/local/v1", "role": "derivation-purpose", "use": "local-data", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "the local data key D = HKDF-SHA256(M, empty salt (the RFC 5869 default zero string), this string); in a data directory with a key store every file the product writes is sealed with D by XChaCha20-Poly1305 in the local data standard's second envelope (galeed-store/local-data-standard.md): magic, algorithm, kind, version, a sixteen-byte identity digest of the file's owner (the data directory's number) and place (its logical name), the nonce; the whole head is the AAD, and the owner and logical name travel again inside the ciphertext. The product takes it through galeed::literals::derivation_purpose(\"local-data\")", "at": "app::keybox::LOCAL_INFO" },
    { "literal": "galeed-local/owner", "role": "derivation-purpose", "use": "local-owner", "sources": ["crates/app/src/local.rs", "crates/app/local-data-standard.md"], "note": "the domain of the owner's half of a sealed local file's identity digest: the first eight bytes of sha256(this string ‖ 0x00 ‖ the owner as text); the product takes it through galeed::literals::derivation_purpose(\"local-owner\")", "at": "app::local::OWNER_DOMAIN" },
    { "literal": "galeed-local/place", "role": "derivation-purpose", "use": "local-place", "sources": ["crates/app/src/local.rs", "crates/app/local-data-standard.md"], "note": "the domain of the place's half of a sealed local file's identity digest: the first eight bytes of sha256(this string ‖ 0x00 ‖ the file's logical name); the product takes it through galeed::literals::derivation_purpose(\"local-place\")", "at": "app::local::PLACE_DOMAIN" },
    { "literal": "galeed-local/2\n", "role": "file-magic", "sources": ["crates/galeed-glue/src/sealed.rs", "crates/app/local-data-standard.md"], "note": "the first bytes of a sealed local file: the local data standard's envelope, the only one written and the only one read (local-seal v3)", "at": "galeed_glue::sealed::MAGIC_V2" },
    { "literal": "galeed-local/gone", "role": "file-magic", "sources": ["crates/app/src/local.rs"], "note": "the gone mark: a whole-machine restore moves the sealed files the new key does not open into `aside/gone-<n>` with a file `gone` holding these bytes, never deleting them", "at": "app::local::GONE" },
    { "literal": "galeed-local/1\n", "role": "file-magic", "sources": ["crates/galeed-glue/src/sealed.rs", "crates/app/local-data-standard.md"], "note": "the local data standard's first envelope (kind and format version bound as additional data, no owner or place): neither written nor opened (local-seal v3); a file that begins with it reads as not sealed, so none is taken for the envelope this version reads", "at": "galeed_glue::sealed::MAGIC" },
    { "literal": "galeed-handoff/1", "role": "file-magic", "sources": ["crates/galeed-seal/src/handover.rs"], "note": "the first line of a ledger handoff's note (`galeed-handoff/1`, then `id <32 hex>` and `after <32 hex or ->`); anything else is no note", "at": "galeed_seal::handover::NOTE_HEAD" },
    { "literal": "galeed-kit-file/1\n", "role": "file-magic", "sources": ["crates/galeed-glue/src/container.rs"], "note": "the header of this product's one-file container (a kit folder's items in one file, manifest first); a ledger handoff kept as one file opens with it", "at": "galeed_glue::container::MAGIC" },
    { "literal": "galeed/cli-credential/1", "role": "aead-domain", "sources": ["crates/galeed-seal/src/credential.rs"], "note": "the associated data the command line's credential seals the master key under (XChaCha20-Poly1305): a credential's sealed key opens only as a credential", "at": "galeed_seal::credential::DOMAIN" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk/keybox/3", "role": "desk-document", "use": "keybox-shape", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "the shape of the vault file (the passcode seal, the recovery seal, the identities' key slots)", "at": "app::keybox::SHAPE" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk/keybox/2", "role": "desk-document", "use": "keybox-shape-2", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "the vault file's second shape, read and rewritten in the third on the next write", "at": "app::keybox::SHAPE_V2" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk/keybox/1", "role": "desk-document", "use": "keybox-shape-1", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "the vault file's first shape, read and rewritten in the third on the next write", "at": "app::keybox::SHAPE_V1" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk/identities/2", "role": "desk-document", "use": "identities-shape", "sources": ["crates/app/src/identity.rs", "crates/galeed-seal/src/identities.rs"], "note": "the shape of the identity register this version writes (each identity, each seat's root, generation and key in office, the current one)", "at": "app::identity::SHAPE" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk/identities/1", "role": "desk-document", "use": "identities-shape-v1", "sources": ["crates/app/src/identity.rs", "crates/galeed-seal/src/identities.rs"], "note": "the earlier shape of the identity register (seats as bare addresses): read once, as each seat's root in office at generation 0, and written back as galeed-desk/identities/2", "at": "app::identity::SHAPE_V1" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk/machine/1", "role": "desk-document", "use": "machine-shape", "sources": ["crates/app/src/machine.rs"], "note": "the shape of this machine's plain settings (locking, the backup reminder, appearance, the command line's sends, the way out)", "at": "app::machine::SHAPE" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk/backup-index/1", "role": "desk-document", "use": "backup-index", "sources": ["crates/app/src/backup.rs"], "note": "the form of a whole-machine backup's index (the files it carries and their places)", "at": "app::backup::INDEX_FORM" },
    { "literal": "galeed/names/v1", "role": "derivation-purpose", "use": "names-key", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "the names key = HKDF-SHA256(M, empty salt, this string): the keyed names of the homes and sealed files, so that a locked machine reveals no identity", "at": "app::keybox::NAMES_INFO" },
    { "literal": "galeed-keybox/2", "role": "derivation-purpose", "use": "keybox-bind", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "the domain binding a vault's seals to that vault (its passcode and recovery seals open nothing else)", "at": "app::keybox::BIND_DOMAIN" },
    { "literal": "galeed/keybox/member/v1", "role": "derivation-purpose", "use": "keybox-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "the purpose of each identity's key slot inside the vault", "at": "app::keybox::MEMBER_INFO" },
    { "literal": "galeed-local/place-key", "role": "derivation-purpose", "use": "local-place-key", "sources": ["crates/app/src/local.rs", "crates/app/local-data-standard.md"], "note": "the purpose of the per-place key of a sealed local file", "at": "app::local::PLACE_KEY_INFO" },
    { "literal": "GALEED_DESK_HOME", "role": "environment", "sources": ["crates/app/src/home.rs"], "note": "names the home this window opens instead of the one the machine's pointer names (tests, a second window)", "at": "app::home::HOME_ENV" },
    { "literal": "galeed-backup/1\n", "role": "backup-envelope", "use": "backup-magic", "sources": ["crates/app/src/backup.rs"], "note": "the first line of a whole-machine backup (its newline included; the second line is the header's canonical JSON, and both lines' bytes are the AAD); its name, the part before the `/`, is the file name's stem: `galeed-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.galeed` (the date in UTC)", "at": "app::backup::MAGIC" },
    { "literal": "galeed", "role": "backup-envelope", "use": "backup-suffix", "pairedWith": "name", "sources": ["crates/app/src/backup.rs"], "note": "the extension of the whole-machine backup file (each family uses its own); the same literal as the command line's name (one of the pairs)", "at": "app::backup::EXT" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk", "role": "backup-envelope", "use": "backup-app", "sources": ["crates/app/src/backup.rs"], "note": "the desktop program's name in the whole-machine backup header (carried in clear); a wrong magic or app name is refused as \"not a GALEED backup\"", "at": "app::backup::APP" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk.protocol/1", "role": "desk-document", "use": "protocol-kind", "sources": ["crates/app/src/protocols.rs"], "note": "the kind at the root of a protocol document: canonical JSON `{items, kind, name, scene, text_md}`; the version hash is the sha256 of the canonical bytes (galeed.papers/1 §1 `doc_id`), which the `protocol` cell of notes and reports takes", "at": "app::protocols::kind_literal()" },
    { "literal": "chelek.proposal/1", "role": "foreign-document", "use": "company-proposal", "sources": ["crates/galeed-anchor/src/proposal.rs"], "note": "the `v` member of a CHELEK proposal file the guild seat exports in company mode: canonical bytes under that law's §2, ten members, the guild's carrying `calls` only; named by its sha256 (`proposalHash`); the company records its typed digest on chain", "at": "galeed_anchor::proposal::VERSION" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk.subscription/1", "role": "desk-document", "use": "subscription-kind", "sources": ["crates/app/src/served.rs"], "note": "the kind at the root of a subscription invitation, handed privately to a verifier: canonical JSON `{at, from, kind, seat, verifier}`, signed by no key and outside the law; the relation itself is read only from the two published lists (galeed.papers/1 §7a.4); a subscription is a relationship, not money: no amount cell, no payout address", "at": "app::served::kind_literal()" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk.accession-request/1", "role": "desk-document", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/succession.rs"], "note": "the kind at the root of an accession request, handed by the new key's desk to the holder's: canonical JSON `{chainId, holder, kind, raw, to}`, `raw` the new key's own `accede(holder)` transaction to the chain's succession book, signed and not sent (galeed.roster/1 §7: the declaration's `to` read from the new key's own signature); signed by no domain", "at": "galeed_cli::succession::REQUEST_KIND" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk.declaration/1", "role": "desk-document", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/succession.rs"], "note": "the kind at the root of a declaration certificate, handed by the holder's desk to the new key's: canonical JSON `{chainId, holder, kind, to, txHash}`, naming the holder the accession takes up (galeed.roster/1 §7); whether the declaration is on the book is the accession's own check on chain", "at": "galeed_cli::succession::DECLARATION_KIND" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk.door/1", "role": "desk-document", "use": "door-form", "sources": ["crates/galeed-glue/src/door.rs"], "note": "the form every frame of the desk's local door carries (four-byte big-endian length, then galeed/1 canonical JSON, at most 1 MiB): the command line's `--home` request and the running desk's reply; a frame of another form is not read (a contact path: the command line writes and reads the door's frames in it)", "at": "galeed_glue::door::FORM" },

    { "literal": ".zikaron-desk", "role": "zikaron-contact", "use": "zikaron-pointer-file", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/zikaron.rs"], "note": "the pointer file name: `~/.zikaron-desk`, one absolute path on one line. The second layer of three-layer discovery; a pointer whose target cannot be read reports that ZIKARON moved and the pointer is stale, and **never falls back to the default**", "at": "galeed_cli::zikaron::pointer_file()" },
    { "literal": ".zikaron-desk.d", "role": "zikaron-contact", "use": "zikaron-default-dir", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/zikaron.rs"], "note": "the default directory name: `~/.zikaron-desk.d/`. The third layer of three-layer discovery", "at": "galeed_cli::zikaron::default_dir()" },
    { "literal": "kits/index.json", "role": "zikaron-contact", "use": "zikaron-index-path", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/zikaron.rs"], "note": "the index of the kits exported on this machine, shaped `{form: \"zikaron.kits-index/1\", kits: [{id, created, root, contents, note_md, path, link?, anchoredOn?, oneTimeKey?}]}` (rows keep unknown members and may lack the optional ones; a row carrying `oneTimeKey` is a record package sealed to one key, which Desk names and never opens); a place holds only when this file's `form` is that literal. A kit's directory is its row's `path`", "at": "galeed_cli::zikaron::index_path()" },
    { "literal": "zikaron.kits-index/1", "role": "zikaron-contact", "use": "zikaron-index-form", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/zikaron.rs", "kit/reference/zikaron-回GALEED-核验结果的落处-2026-10-02.md §三"], "note": "the form literal of ZIKARON's kit index, read by the literal and never by an integer version; when the shape changes, ZIKARON changes this literal", "at": "galeed_cli::zikaron::index_form()" },
    { "literal": "kits/verified", "role": "zikaron-contact", "use": "zikaron-verified-dir", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/zikaron.rs", "kit/reference/zikaron-回GALEED-核验结果的落处-2026-10-02.md §二"], "note": "where ZIKARON lays its verification results in the machine directory: `kits/verified/<manifestSha256>.json`, one per kit it checked, named by the sha256 of that kit's MANIFEST bytes; Desk opens it by that name and never writes", "at": "galeed_cli::zikaron::verified_dir()" },
    { "literal": "manifest.json", "role": "zikaron-contact", "use": "zikaron-kit-manifest", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/zikaron.rs", "zikaron.kit/1 (a kit's MANIFEST at its root)"], "note": "a ZIKARON kit's MANIFEST file at the kit's root: Desk reads its bytes (their sha256 names the verification result) and where it says it is anchored (its `anchoredOn` member, else its `note_md`'s landing line), and never writes it", "at": "galeed_cli::zikaron::kit_manifest()" },
    { "literal": "anchoredOn", "role": "zikaron-contact", "use": "zikaron-anchored-on", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/zikaron.rs", "zikaron.kit/2 §4.3 (a kit's MANIFEST member)"], "note": "where a ZIKARON kit says it is anchored, `{chainId, fromBlock, registry}`: the member of a `zikaron.kit/2` MANIFEST (ZIKARON 0.2.0) and of a kit index row; Desk reads the MANIFEST's first, then the MANIFEST note's last line, then the row's, and says when two of them differ; read, never written", "at": "galeed_cli::zikaron::KEY_ANCHORED_ON" },
    { "literal": "zikaron.kit-verification/1", "role": "zikaron-contact", "use": "zikaron-verification-form", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/zikaron.rs", "kit/reference/zikaron-回GALEED-核验结果的落处-2026-10-02.md §二"], "note": "the form literal of a ZIKARON verification result (a foreign document Desk only reads): `{form, manifestSha256, at, kitVerdict, kit?, records[{content, anchor|null}], anchors, basis?, core}`; a file whose form is not this literal counts as absent", "at": "galeed_cli::zikaron::verification_form()" },
    { "literal": "zikaron-kit-file/1\n", "role": "zikaron-contact", "use": "zikaron-kit-file", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/zikaron.rs", "ZIKARON 11e1077a crates/zikaron-glue/src/container.rs (its one-file kit header)"], "note": "the header of a ZIKARON kit kept as one file (its record package): Desk reads such a kit's MANIFEST and files alike with a kit folder's (`zikaron::kit_manifest_bytes`, `zikaron::kit_folder`) and never writes one", "at": "galeed_cli::zikaron::kit_file_magic()" },
    { "literal": "zikaron-kit-addressed\n", "role": "zikaron-contact", "use": "zikaron-kit-addressed", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/zikaron.rs", "ZIKARON 11e1077a crates/zikaron-glue/src/addressed.rs (the header of its record package sealed to one key)"], "note": "the header of a ZIKARON record package sealed to one key (ZIKARON 0.1.4): Desk recognises such a package by this header (or its index row's `oneTimeKey`), names it and refuses to read it as evidence (`zikaron::is_addressed`); it never opens one and never writes one", "at": "galeed_cli::zikaron::addressed_magic()" },
    { "literal": "zkit", "role": "zikaron-contact", "sources": ["crates/galeed-glue/src/container.rs", "ZIKARON 11e1077a crates/zikaron-glue/src/container.rs"], "note": "the extension (without the dot) of ZIKARON's record package, a kit kept as one file; Desk reads it and writes none", "at": "galeed_glue::container::EXT_KIT" },

    { "literal": "ZIKARON", "role": "zikaron-contact", "sources": ["crates/galeed-os/src/lib.rs", "ZIKARON eafacd6e crates/zikaron-os/src/windows.rs (its app folder)"], "note": "ZIKARON's folder in the local application data folder on Windows, where its pointer `.zikaron-desk` and default directory `.zikaron-desk.d` are: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\\ZIKARON\\.zikaron-desk`. Read, never written; spelled as ZIKARON spells it. The platform crate holds it as a constant because it depends on no crate that reads this registry", "at": "galeed_os::ZIKARON_FOLDER" },

    { "literal": "GALEED", "role": "name", "pairedWith": "request-product-name", "sources": ["crates/app/src/home.rs", "crates/app/build.rs"], "note": "the product's name: the folder opened inside a non-empty folder when a home is moved there, and the product name and file description of the window program's Windows version resource (spelled there in the build script's version table)", "at": "app::home::HOME_STEM" },
    { "literal": "local.galeed.desk", "role": "name", "sources": ["the macOS application bundle's CFBundleIdentifier"], "note": "the bundle identifier of the macOS application. No place in the public code: today only the private release tool spells it, in the property list it writes into the bundle", "at": null },
    { "literal": "UTC--", "role": "name", "sources": ["crates/app/src/actions.rs"], "note": "the head of an exported key file's name, the convention other wallets read: `UTC--<the export's UTC second as YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SS>.000000000Z--<address without 0x>`", "at": "app::actions::KEYSTORE_PREFIX" },
    { "literal": "galeed-os-", "role": "name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-os/src/lib.rs"], "note": "the head of the scratch directories the platform crate's tests make in the temporary directory, so they never meet another product's", "at": "galeed_os::TEST_DIR_HEAD" },
    { "literal": "galeed-mdedit", "role": "name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-ui/src/own/mdedit.rs"], "note": "the head of the ids the Markdown editor (family component md-editor) keeps each text's cursor, undo history and scrolling under; a product taking the component spells its own name here", "at": "galeed_ui::own::mdedit::ID_HEAD" },
    { "literal": "galeed-ask-", "role": "name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-chain/src/endpoints.rs"], "note": "the head of the thread names one question to every node runs on (`galeed-ask-<i>`, one thread per node), so a stack or a profile names them as this product's", "at": "galeed_chain::endpoints::ASK_THREAD" },
    { "literal": "galeed", "literalSepolia": "galeed-sepolia", "role": "name", "pairedWith": "backup-envelope", "sources": ["crates/galeed-os/src/cli_path.rs"], "note": "the command line's name on the shell's command path (the Sepolia trial build's own, `literalSepolia`, beside the mainnet build's) (\"enable command line\" links it there, or adds its folder to the user's Path on Windows); the same literal as the whole-machine backup file's extension (one of the pairs) (a contact path: the terminal finds the command line by it)", "at": "galeed_os::cli_path::NAME" },
    { "literal": "galeed-desk-door-", "role": "name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-os/src/door.rs"], "note": "the head of every local door's name (a socket file in the machine directory, or a named pipe on Windows), followed by sixteen hex digits naming the machine and data directories (a contact path: the command line finds the running desk's door by it)", "at": "galeed_os::door::NAME_HEAD" },
    { "literal": "GALEED", "role": "request-product-name", "pairedWith": "name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-net/src/lib.rs"], "note": "the User-Agent every request to a node or a remote file carries: the product's name alone, no version, system or machine", "at": "galeed_net::USER_AGENT" },
    { "literal": "GALEED_DESK_TIMEOUT_SECS", "role": "environment", "sources": ["crates/galeed-net/src/lib.rs"], "note": "overrides one exchange's whole deadline, in seconds (default 30; zero means none)", "at": "galeed_net::env::TIMEOUT_SECS" },
    { "literal": "GALEED_DESK_TIMEOUT_MS", "role": "environment", "sources": ["crates/galeed-net/src/lib.rs"], "note": "overrides one exchange's whole deadline in milliseconds, before the seconds one (for deadlines under a second)", "at": "galeed_net::env::TIMEOUT_MS" },
    { "literal": "GALEED_DESK_MAX_ANSWER_BYTES", "role": "environment", "sources": ["crates/galeed-net/src/lib.rs"], "note": "overrides the most bytes one answer may have, head and body together (default 64 MiB; zero means none)", "at": "galeed_net::env::MAX_ANSWER_BYTES" },
    { "literal": "GALEED_DESK_TRACE", "role": "environment", "sources": ["crates/galeed/src/marks.rs"], "note": "where the trace channel writes its marks; unset, marks go nowhere", "at": "galeed::marks::ENV" },
    { "literal": "GALEED_DESK_TRACE_CAP_BYTES", "role": "environment", "sources": [".cargo/config.toml", "crates/galeed/src/marks.rs"], "note": "the byte cap of the trace sink file, given once by the build environment (`[env]` of `.cargo/config.toml`) and read at compile time with `env!` into `galeed::marks::TRACE_CAP_BYTES`; a build environment variable, not one read while running", "at": "galeed::marks::CAP_ENV" },
    { "literal": "GALEED_DESK_CLI_LINK_DIR", "role": "environment", "sources": ["crates/galeed-os/src/cli_path.rs"], "note": "redirects where \"enable command line\" writes (tests, the drive): the folder its link goes in, or on Windows a folder holding stand-ins for the user's and the machine's Path; system folders are then never touched and no administrator dialog is asked", "at": "galeed_os::cli_path::ENV_DIR" },
    { "literal": ".galeed-desk-pointer", "literalSepolia": ".galeed-desk-sepolia-pointer", "role": "name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-os/src/places.rs", "crates/galeed-os/src/machine.rs"], "note": "the pointer file, beside the machine directory in the place the system keeps this desk's data, naming the machine directory elsewhere (one absolute path line; the family's machine lookup reads it first). Not the data directory's name `.galeed-desk`, a directory beside it; this desk writes no pointer (a contact path: the command line and other programs find the machine directory through it)", "at": "galeed_os::machine::POINTER" },
    { "literal": ".galeed-desk.d", "literalSepolia": ".galeed-desk-sepolia.d", "role": "name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-os/src/places.rs", "crates/galeed-os/src/machine.rs"], "note": "the default machine directory, in the place the system keeps this desk's data, when no pointer names another (a contact path: the command line and other programs find the machine directory by it)", "at": "galeed_os::machine::APP_DIR" },

    { "literal": "zikaron-kit/", "role": "kit-prefix", "use": "kit-prefix", "sources": ["courtevidence/1 §2.2 (files row)", "crates/app/src/dossier.rs"], "note": "a manifest file item's `name` = this prefix + the path inside the kit; the bytes' sha256 and `size` are checked as usual. Desk only labels an item with this prefix as a ZIKARON disclosure kit and offers an \"open in ZIKARON\" key, **checks no kit and reads no numbers**; it is judged byte for byte like an ordinary file", "at": "app::dossier::kit_prefix()" },

    { "literal": "actions", "role": "venue-declaration", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/names.rs"], "note": "the member name of a standard item's write-call table; each row records the function name, the input shape, the target and a human label, and Desk builds a generic form from the type string. The same rule as `views`, which lives with the rules body member names in `app::amanah::member`", "at": "galeed_cli::names::S_ACTIONS" },
    { "literal": "quoteKeys", "role": "venue-declaration", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/names.rs"], "note": "the member name by which a standard item narrows its quote keys; its closed set of two values (`any` by default, `token` admitting only the form with a settlement token), whose closed set and reading live in `galeed_roster::QuoteKeys`. The two values are not registered: `token` is spelled like the quote-field synonym, and registering both would be a cross-role repeat (reading ② allows only the registered pairs); see §3", "at": "galeed_cli::names::S_QUOTE_KEYS" },
    { "literal": "submitters", "role": "venue-declaration", "sources": ["crates/galeed-cli/src/names.rs"], "note": "an optional member name on both address items and standard items: the extra submitter addresses the judge declares for that venue (relays, certification bodies; may be empty). Desk reads it without interpreting it, only merging it into the `by` set of the default committed-set query, never into any judgment. In the product it lives in `galeed_cli::names::S_SUBMITTERS`", "at": "galeed_cli::names::S_SUBMITTERS" },

    { "literal": "autoAccept", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "one of the three reserved names: standing consent. In the product it lives in `app::amanah::field::AUTO_ACCEPT`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::AUTO_ACCEPT" },
    { "literal": "token", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "the settlement token cell (a reserved name); spelled like the venue seat field `token`, here it is the Desk role name", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::TOKEN" },
    { "literal": "feeUnit", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "the reference token cell, **which decides between the two forms** (non-zero is the converted form, zero the direct form); synonym `referenceToken`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEE_UNIT[0]" },
    { "literal": "referenceToken", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "a synonym of `feeUnit`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEE_UNIT[1]" },
    { "literal": "feedToken", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "the price source cell on the settlement token side; synonym `priceSourceToken`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEED_TOKEN[0]" },
    { "literal": "priceSourceToken", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "a synonym of `feedToken`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEED_TOKEN[1]" },
    { "literal": "feedUnit", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "the price source cell on the reference token side; synonym `priceSourceUnit`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEED_UNIT[0]" },
    { "literal": "priceSourceUnit", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "a synonym of `feedUnit`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEED_UNIT[1]" },
    { "literal": "maxStale", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "the price source staleness bound; synonym `priceMaxAge`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::MAX_STALE[0]" },
    { "literal": "priceMaxAge", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "a synonym of `maxStale`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::MAX_STALE[1]" },
    { "literal": "premiumBps", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "the standby fee cell (a ratio; what a seating earned reads back from `seatOf.standbyCredited`); synonym `standbyBps`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::PREMIUM[0]" },
    { "literal": "standbyBps", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "a synonym of `premiumBps`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::PREMIUM[1]" },
    { "literal": "feeFixed", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "one of the four litigation fee cells: the base fee; synonym `feeBase`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEE_FIXED[0]" },
    { "literal": "feeBase", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "a synonym of `feeFixed`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEE_FIXED[1]" },
    { "literal": "feeBps", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "one of the four litigation fee cells: the ratio; synonym `feeRateBps`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEE_BPS[0]" },
    { "literal": "feeRateBps", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "a synonym of `feeBps`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEE_BPS[1]" },
    { "literal": "feeMin", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "one of the four litigation fee cells: the floor; synonym `feeFloor`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEE_MIN[0]" },
    { "literal": "feeFloor", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "a synonym of `feeMin`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEE_MIN[1]" },
    { "literal": "feeMax", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "one of the four litigation fee cells: the cap; synonym `feeCap`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEE_MAX[0]" },
    { "literal": "feeCap", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "a synonym of `feeMax`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::FEE_MAX[1]" },
    { "literal": "amountCap", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "the subject amount cap (filled once from the same source as the rules amount cap); synonym `subjectCap`. The view role closed set has a role name spelled the same; **only the quote one is registered** (cross-role repeats are allowed only for the registered pairs; see §3)", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::AMOUNT_CAP[0]" },
    { "literal": "subjectCap", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "a synonym of `amountCap`", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::AMOUNT_CAP[1]" },
    { "literal": "lapseDefault", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "the share a seat lapses at when its judge does not rule in time or resigns, a desk role (ERAVON standard §3: 0, 1 or 2, none, half or all of the amount back to the buyer); the studio and the guild covenant draw it as one three-way choice, never a free number", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::LAPSE_DEFAULT" },
    { "literal": "rulingWindow", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "one of the two clocks, in seconds (ERAVON standard §3): how long the judge has to rule after a case opens; zero is not set and the publish gate refuses it", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::RULING_WINDOW" },
    { "literal": "offerWindow", "role": "quote-field", "sources": ["crates/galeed-venue/src/quote.rs"], "note": "one of the two clocks, in seconds (ERAVON standard §3): how long a seat offer stays open for acceptance; zero is not set and the publish gate refuses it", "at": "galeed_venue::quote::field::OFFER_WINDOW" },


    { "literal": ".entry", "role": "ledger-layout", "sources": ["crates/galeed-store/src/layout.rs"], "note": "an entry file's suffix in a ledger directory (`<64 hex digits>.entry`)", "at": "galeed_store::layout::ENTRY_SUFFIX" },
    { "literal": ".gls-tmp-", "role": "ledger-layout", "sources": ["crates/galeed-store/src/layout.rs"], "note": "the head of a ledger directory's temporary file while an entry is being written (the head, then a random nonce); a sweep removes only this exact shape", "at": "galeed_store::layout::TMP_PREFIX" },

    { "literal": "identities", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-store/src/places.rs"], "note": "the directory of identities in a working directory (`identities/<address>/…`)", "at": "galeed_store::places::IDENTITIES" },
    { "literal": "papers", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-store/src/places.rs"], "note": "the papers directory under an identity (and the home's desk room, `app::home::Slot::Desk`, spelled the same: one literal)", "at": "galeed_store::places::PAPERS" },
    { "literal": "settings.json", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-store/src/places.rs"], "note": "an identity's settings file", "at": "galeed_store::places::SETTINGS" },
    { "literal": "formatVersion", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-store/src/places.rs"], "note": "the member naming the layout's format version in a format record (`format.json`)", "at": "galeed_store::places::KEY_FORMAT_VERSION" },
    { "literal": "precedent-index.json", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-store/src/places.rs"], "note": "the precedent index file under papers", "at": "galeed_store::places::fixed::PRECEDENT_INDEX" },
    { "literal": "pending-anchors.json", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-store/src/places.rs", "CLI-SCHEMA.md"], "note": "the anchors waiting to be sent, under papers (its path form is in the contract)", "at": "galeed_store::places::fixed::PENDING_ANCHORS" },
    { "literal": "roster-calls", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-store/src/places.rs"], "note": "the directory of a guild press's call files, under papers", "at": "galeed_store::places::fixed::ROSTER_CALLS" },
    { "literal": "engagements.json", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-store/src/places.rs"], "note": "the verifier's engagements, under papers", "at": "galeed_store::places::fixed::ENGAGEMENTS" },
    { "literal": "draws.json", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/app/src/panel.rs"], "note": "the guild's draw record, under papers: where the watch read to, the cases it watches, the last draw sent, the key it draws from", "at": "app::panel::DRAWS_FILE" },
    { "literal": "settings", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/app/src/home.rs"], "note": "the home's settings room, where the writer lock and the writer mark lie", "at": "app::home::Slot::Settings.as_str()" },
    { "literal": "anchor", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/app/src/places.rs"], "note": "the key account the key vault and its lock are named by (`keys-anchor.json`, `keys-anchor.lock`)", "at": "app::places::ACCOUNT" },
    { "literal": "opened-seats.json", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/app/src/desk_port.rs"], "note": "the guild and verifier seats opened by their opening act, per identity (`identity`, `seat`, `address`), in the machine directory's desk room; written only by that act (`desk_port::open_unsigned`)", "at": "app::desk_port::OPENED_FILE" },
    { "literal": "galeed-handoff.txt", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-glue/src/names.rs", "crates/app/src/archive.rs"], "note": "a ledger handoff's note (`galeed_seal::handover::Note`), laid beside the bundle a hand-over exports (`archive::hand_over`) and read by the receipt (`archive::receive`); a bundle without it is no handoff", "at": "galeed_glue::names::HANDOFF_NOTE" },
    { "literal": "glhand", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-glue/src/container.rs"], "note": "the extension (without the dot) of a ledger handoff kept as one file in the one-file container (`galeed_glue::container`); the receipt reads the single file and the folder alike", "at": "galeed_glue::container::EXT_HAND" },
    { "literal": "cli-pass-", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-seal/src/places.rs", "crates/galeed-seal/src/credential.rs"], "note": "the head of the command line's credential file in the machine directory (`cli-pass-<account>.json`): owner-only, the master key sealed in it under the credential's own key, issued by the desktop when writing alone is turned on", "at": "galeed_seal::places::credential_file_for" },
    { "literal": "sealed-machine-", "role": "data-name", "sources": ["crates/galeed-seal/src/places.rs", "crates/app/src/machine.rs"], "note": "the head of the machine settings' sealed part in the machine directory (`sealed-machine-<account>`): everything but the appearance and the language, which stay plain (`machine.json`)", "at": "galeed_seal::places::machine_file_for" },

    { "literal": "keys-", "role": "plain-file", "sources": ["crates/galeed-seal/src/places.rs"], "note": "the head of the key vault file and its lock file in the machine directory (`keys-<account>.json`, `keys-<account>.lock`); left plain by design: the vault's contents are already encrypted and the lock is never read", "at": "galeed_seal::places::keybox_file_for" },
    { "literal": "machine.json", "role": "plain-file", "sources": ["crates/app/src/machine.rs", "crates/app/src/local.rs"], "note": "the machine settings file in the machine directory; left plain by design: read before unlocking", "at": "app::machine::FILE" },
    { "literal": "picked-home.json", "role": "plain-file", "sources": ["crates/app/src/home.rs", "crates/app/src/local.rs"], "note": "the chosen-home record in the machine directory; left plain by design: read before unlocking", "at": "app::home::PICKED" },
    { "literal": "machine-mark", "role": "plain-file", "sources": ["crates/app/src/lock.rs", "crates/app/src/local.rs"], "note": "this machine's mark in the machine directory; left plain by design: the writer mark names it before unlocking", "at": "app::lock::MACHINE_FILE" },
    { "literal": "writer.lock", "role": "plain-file", "sources": ["crates/app/src/lock.rs", "crates/app/src/local.rs"], "note": "the home's single-writer lock file (under its settings room); left plain by design: a lock file, never read", "at": "app::lock::LOCK_FILE" },
    { "literal": "writer-mark", "role": "plain-file", "sources": ["crates/app/src/lock.rs", "crates/app/src/local.rs"], "note": "the home's writer mark (under its settings room); left plain by design: read before unlocking", "at": "app::lock::MARK_FILE" },
    { "literal": "pens-handed", "role": "plain-file", "sources": ["crates/galeed-seal/src/pens.rs"], "note": "the pens of the ledgers this machine handed or took, one line each under a blind key (`galeed_seal::pens`: the salted digest of the ledger's root, never the root); left plain by design: every writer asks it before an entry, locked or not", "at": "galeed_seal::pens::FILE" },
    { "literal": "blind-salt", "role": "plain-file", "sources": ["crates/galeed-seal/src/adopted.rs"], "note": "this machine's salt for its blind lists (32 random bytes, one line of hex, made on first use): the pens list and the adopted list key ledgers under it", "at": "galeed_seal::adopted::SALT_FILE" },
    { "literal": "taken-ledgers", "role": "plain-file", "sources": ["crates/galeed-seal/src/adopted.rs"], "note": "the blind list of ledgers this machine adopted (`galeed_seal::adopted`), one salted digest per line; left plain by design, as the salt", "at": "galeed_seal::adopted::LIST_FILE" },

    { "literal": "shape", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::SHAPE" },
    { "literal": "wrong", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::WRONG" },
    { "literal": "kdf", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::KDF" },
    { "literal": "marks", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::MARKS" },
    { "literal": "primary", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::PRIMARY" },
    { "literal": "pin", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::PIN" },
    { "literal": "recovery", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "pairedWith": "derivation-purpose", "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`); spelled like the derivation purpose `recovery`, listed as a pair", "at": "app::keybox::member::RECOVERY" },
    { "literal": "slots", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::SLOTS" },
    { "literal": "ct", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::CT" },
    { "literal": "iv", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::IV" },
    { "literal": "salt", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::SALT" },
    { "literal": "mac", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::MAC" },
    { "literal": "bind", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::BIND" },
    { "literal": "id", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::ID" },
    { "literal": "tag", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::TAG" },
    { "literal": "name", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::NAME" },
    { "literal": "account", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::ACCOUNT" },
    { "literal": "kind", "role": "vault-member", "sources": ["crates/app/src/keybox.rs"], "note": "a member name of the key vault file (`keys-<account>.json`)", "at": "app::keybox::member::KIND" },

    { "literal": "Declared", "role": "book-abi", "sources": ["base/galeed-core/contracts/src/GaleedSuccessionBook.sol", "galeed.roster/1 §4.1"], "abi": {"kind": "event", "signature": "Declared(address,address)"}, "note": "from and to indexed; a declaration of the logs set (§4.1); `at` holds its signature", "at": "galeed_anchor::abi::BOOK_DECLARED" },

    { "literal": "to", "role": "book-abi", "sources": ["base/galeed-core/contracts/src/GaleedSuccessionBook.sol", "galeed.roster/1 §4.1"], "abi": {"kind": "parameter", "signature": "address indexed to"}, "note": "the second member of Declared (the key declared to) and of Acceded (the acceding key, an accession's emitter) No place of its own in the code: a parameter name, spelled only inside the book's `sol!` declaration.", "at": null },

  "derivationPaths": {
    "form": "m/44'/60'/<project>'/<group>/<index>",
    "sources": ["crates/galeed/src/cryptox.rs"],
    "note": "the family derivation path table: the account position is the project (ZIKARON 0', GALEED 1', ERAVON 2'), one number per role, the same table across tools. The judge reference in ERAVON points at the GALEED judge number and takes no number of its own; the buyer key 2'/1/0 is standing and per-case 2'/1/i optional, written in the table as one row with the placeholder {i}. A path is spelled by its group in one place (`app::family::path_at`); this product's seat keys sit at group 0, the rows below, and a key change goes to a key given, never to a later group",
    "entries": [
      { "path": "m/44'/60'/0'/0/0", "family": "zikaron", "project": 0, "role": "author" },
      { "path": "m/44'/60'/0'/0/1", "family": "zikaron", "project": 0, "role": "delegate" },
      { "path": "m/44'/60'/1'/0/0", "family": "galeed", "project": 1, "role": "judge" },
      { "path": "m/44'/60'/1'/0/1", "family": "galeed", "project": 1, "role": "guild" },
      { "path": "m/44'/60'/1'/0/2", "family": "galeed", "project": 1, "role": "verifier" },
      { "path": "m/44'/60'/2'/0/0", "family": "eravon", "project": 2, "role": "seller" },
      { "path": "m/44'/60'/2'/1/{i}", "family": "eravon", "project": 2, "role": "buyer-case" }
    ]
  },

    "chelekProxyCodeHash": { "value": "0xd835290ef8e1e5d59fb0272ad79e6bc1ee710c1dcc1050874678e75a666bde6e", "sources": ["chelek-standard/CODEHASH.md (mainnet row)", "crates/galeed-anchor/src/chelek.rs"], "note": "a CHELEK company's extcodehash (the guild seat's one identity check in company mode); the generated constants file carries it with the logic and the public deployer, all three from that row" },
    "keystoreScryptMaxMemory": { "value": 1073741824, "unit": "bytes", "sources": ["crates/galeed/src/cryptox.rs"], "note": "importing a keystore v3, scrypt memory 128·r·n is at most this (1 GiB); beyond it the import is refused as keystore-params without doing the work" },
    "keystoreScryptMaxP": { "value": 16, "unit": "count", "sources": ["crates/galeed/src/cryptox.rs"], "note": "scrypt parallelism p is at most this" },
    "keystoreScryptMaxWork": { "value": 4294967296, "unit": "bytes", "sources": ["crates/galeed/src/cryptox.rs"], "note": "scrypt total work 128·r·n·p is at most this (4 GiB)" },
    "keystorePbkdf2MaxRounds": { "value": 16777216, "unit": "rounds", "sources": ["crates/galeed/src/cryptox.rs"], "note": "pbkdf2 rounds are at most this (2^24; other wallets write 262,144)" }

```

## 3 · Divergences and gaps (how the registry reads them)

- `courtjson/1` does not appear in the five law texts (galeed/1, galeed.papers/1, galeed.venue/1, galeed.roster/1, courtevidence/1); it names the canonical form of galeed/1 §3, and its `note` says so.
- `galeed/1` is both a signing domain (§5.6) and the value of an entry's `spec` (§4.1), a double use the law itself sets; it is registered only as `signing-domain`, not as `spec-label` (otherwise it would be a cross-role repeat outside the registered pairs). zikaron.kit/1 uses the same form twice in its own law.
- The eight entry type names of galeed/1 §6 are bare words that live in the base and are not family literals; the family registers only the prefixed `galeed.dispatch/1`.
- None of the four names in the closed set of view roles is registered. `amountCap` is spelled the same as a quote-field synonym, so registering both would be a cross-role repeat, which reading ② allows only for the registered pairs; `rateAt`, `price` and `none` are not registered either. The closed set of four lives in `galeed_cli::names::VIEW_ROLES`; what a ruling or an advance pays and what a seating earned are read from the venue's `outcomeOf`, `advanceOf` and `seatOf` (`galeed.venue/1` §2.3, §2.12), never through a declared view.
- The two values of `quoteKeys` (`any`, `token`) are not registered: `token` is spelled byte for byte like the quote-field synonym, so registering both would be a cross-role repeat, which reading ② allows only for the registered pairs; registering `any` alone means nothing (half a closed set in the registry reads worse than none). The closed set and its reading live in `galeed_roster::{QUOTE_KEYS_ANY, QUOTE_KEYS_TOKEN, QuoteKeys}`.
- The `quote-field` family and `galeed_venue::quote::field` are two spellings of one table: the registry is the contract, and the module is what the product reads by it (the shell, the command line and the adapter read the one table; `app::amanah::field` re-exports it). The two must not drift: an app test reads the registry and compares name by name (`the_quote_field_family_is_exactly_what_the_registry_registers`).
- Three spellings coincide across roles and are listed as pairs, though they name different things: `entry` is a parameter of the registry's `anchorCarried` and `Anchored` (`registry-abi`) and the label a keyed entry name is derived under (`keyed-label`); `publish` is the registry's one publishing call (`registry-abi`) and a duty item's name (`duty-item`); `recovery` is a derivation purpose and a member of the key vault file (`vault-member`).
- The layout's numbers (the temporary file's nonce length, an entry's size cap, the format version) and the chain this build supports are not literals: the drive door answers them (`fixed`), each from the one constant the product reads.
- The `duty-item` role is the whole closed set the duty table's three seats list; a test in `app::duty` reads this registry and compares the two sets.
